teach_overlay.scale: a pinhole camera needs no lens, so why does your eye have one? Because a pinhole tiny enough to make a sharp image lets in almost no light — your eye's lens lets your pupil open a hundred times wider in the dark while bending every spread-out ray back to a single pinpoint on your retina
